Get Involved

Join us

We’re on the front lines of the issues that affect LGBTQ Ohioans — from discrimination to HIV policy reform to pushing back against conversion therapy — Equality Ohio is there. If you support LGBTQ equality, you’re a part of the Equality Ohio family.

Ways In

Pick how you show up

Volunteer

Volunteer near you

Sign up to volunteer with our teams in Northeast, Central, and Southwest Ohio — or virtually from anywhere in the state.

Sign up to volunteer

Come to an event

Come and help us make Ohio a state we can all call home! See what’s coming up on the Equality Ohio events calendar.

Ways to give

Get the latest

Real change starts with you. Learn about the work of Equality Ohio and our partners across the state and country as we build legal and lived equality for LGBTQ+ people.

Legal Clinic

Get free legal help

Facing discrimination or a legal problem? The Equality Ohio Legal Clinic is free — call 855‑LGBT‑LAW or start an intake online.

Visit the Legal Clinic
Giving Programs

More ways to give

Monthly Giving

Defenders of Equality

For just $15 a month, you can be a Defender of Equality. You’ll receive a welcome pack, exclusive gear, and opportunities to network and meet other Defenders at our monthly happy hour — with a free drink ticket each month, too.

Become a Defender
Donor Advised Funds

Give through your DAF

A donor-advised fund, or DAF, is a giving vehicle established at a public charity. You may have one established already — use it directly for Equality Ohio.

Get the details: give through your DAF
In-Kind Giving

Donate goods & gear

Office supplies, outdoor festival equipment, and gift cards all help to defray our costs and direct more of our resources toward the work of bringing full equality to Ohio.

Get the details: donate goods & gear

Come and help us make Ohio a state we can all call home.

Volunteer with a regional team, show up to an event, or fuel the work with a gift — every bit of it moves equality forward.

Sign Up to Volunteer Donate

Ohio’s statewide LGBTQ+ advocacy and legal aid organization — working toward an Ohio where justice, dignity, and self-determination belong to everyone.
